# Bolt Route Docs

## Docs

- [API behavior](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/api-behavior.md): Global request/response conventions, error format, and dependency behavior.
- [Authorization](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/authorization.md): Authorize requests with your API key.
- [Create Plant](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoint/create.md): Creates a new plant in the store
- [Delete Plant](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoint/delete.md): Deletes a single plant based on the ID supplied
- [Get Plants](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoint/get.md): Returns all plants from the system that the user has access to
- [Create API key](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/api-keys/create-key.md): Create a new API key.
- [Get API key usage](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/api-keys/get-key-usage.md): Retrieve usage data for a single API key.
- [List API keys](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/api-keys/list-keys.md): List active API keys.
- [Revoke API key](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/api-keys/revoke-key.md): Revoke an API key.
- [API key usage summary](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/api-keys/usage-summary.md): Usage metrics for API keys.
- [Create batch verification task](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/create-task.md): Create a batch verification task for up to 10,000 emails.
- [Download batch verification results](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/download-results.md): Download batch verification results as a file.
- [Get batch verification task](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/get-task.md): Retrieve a batch verification task with aggregated metrics.
- [List batch verification tasks](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/list-tasks.md): List batch verification tasks with optional filters.
- [Batch verification metrics fields](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/metrics-fields.md): Field definitions for batch verification metrics.
- [Batch verification jobs](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/task-jobs.md): List email jobs for a batch verification task.
- [Batch verification series](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/batch-verification/task-series.md): Daily metrics series for a batch verification task.
- [Retrieve user balance](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/credit/balance.md): Retrieve the current user credit balance.
- [List transactions](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/credit/transactions.md): List user credit transactions.
- [Credit usage series](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/credit/usage.md): Retrieve daily used, granted, and net credit totals for a date range.
- [Credit usage by API key](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/credit/usage-by-api-keys.md): Retrieve daily credit usage grouped by API key, including unknown attribution rows.
- [Get upload status](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/file-upload/get-upload-status.md): Fetch the status of a file upload and its task.
- [Upload file](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/file-upload/upload-file.md): Upload a file for batch verification.
- [Metrics](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/metrics-controller.md): Reference documentation for metrics.
- [Realtime verification](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/endpoints/realtime-verification.md): Reference documentation for realtime verification.
- [Introduction](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/introduction.md): Verify emails with Bolt Route's API before you send.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.boltroute.ai/api-reference/webhooks.md): Receive per-email and task completion webhook notifications.
- [Context7](https://docs.boltroute.ai/guides/context7-compatibility.md): Use Bolt Route docs as a Context7 source for accurate, cited answers.
- [DeepWiki](https://docs.boltroute.ai/guides/deepwiki-compatibility.md): Use Bolt Route docs as a DeepWiki source for reliable reference answers.
- [LLMs.txt](https://docs.boltroute.ai/guides/llms-txt.md): Official LLMs.txt entry for Bolt Route documentation.
- [Introduction](https://docs.boltroute.ai/index.md): A practical guide to verifying emails and protecting deliverability
- [Google Sheets](https://docs.boltroute.ai/integrations/google-sheets.md): Verify emails in Google Sheets using the Bolt Route add-on.
- [Make.com](https://docs.boltroute.ai/integrations/make.md): Verify emails in Make.com using the Bolt Route custom app.
- [n8n](https://docs.boltroute.ai/integrations/n8n.md): Verify emails in n8n using Bolt Route.
- [Zapier](https://docs.boltroute.ai/integrations/zapier.md): Verify emails in Zapier using Bolt Route.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.boltroute.ai/quickstart.md): Verify your first email in minutes via API or file upload.
- [Batch List Cleaning](https://docs.boltroute.ai/scenarios/batch-list-cleaning.md): Clean large email lists before campaigns or CRM imports using batch verification.
- [Ongoing List Hygiene](https://docs.boltroute.ai/scenarios/ongoing-list-hygiene.md): Re-verify dormant lists on a schedule to keep deliverability and reactivation campaigns healthy.
- [Realtime Signup Verification](https://docs.boltroute.ai/scenarios/realtime-signup-verification.md): Verify emails at signup or lead capture using realtime checks and clear accept/hold/reject rules.
- [Webhook Automation](https://docs.boltroute.ai/scenarios/webhook-automation.md): Automate verification flows by receiving webhook events and updating downstream tools.
